# type

Manage custom environment type definitions

## Usage

```
ppds env type [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | Type name (Production, Sandbox, Development, Test, Trial) |

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--color` | `-c` | `EnvironmentColor?` |  | Default color for this type |
| `--list` |  | `bool` |  | List all type definitions (built-in + custom) |
| `--remove` |  | `bool` |  | Remove this custom type definition |
